spans.s:
पोल m. (-लः)
 1. Magnitude, bulk.
 2. A heap, a quantity.
 E. पुल् to be great, घञ् aff.
पोलिका f. (-का) Flat cakes made of barley or wheat, &c.

पोलिन्द m. (-न्दः)
 1. A part of a boat supporting the deck, (the knees or
ribs of a boat.)
 2. The mast of a ship.
 E. पोल magnitude, इदि to be
supreme, aff. अच् ।
